framework.name: C3 Framework economics indicators and the National Standards for Personal Financial Education (K–8), the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science (Economics and Financial Literacy, 9–12), with the Council for Economic Education Voluntary National Content Standards in Economics
framework.short: C3 D2.Eco K–8 / IL SS.EC 9–12 / CEE
framework.note: Codes are C3 economics indicators (D2.Eco.x.band) and the 2021 National Standards for Personal Financial Education (named by area) for K–8, Illinois 9–12 economics and financial-literacy standards (SS.EC.x.9-12, SS.EC.FL.x.9-12), and CEE Voluntary National Content Standards in Economics, 2nd ed. 2010 (CEE 1–20); alignment was made by the course author and is not a certification by any of these bodies.
